name: Rustomjee Crown
address: Gokhale Road South, opposite Sportsmed Hospital, Prabhadevi, Mumbai 400025
amenities: 60+ amenities on a 2.52-acre open-to-sky multi-level podium
description: A 5.75-acre gated estate of three sea-facing towers on Gokhale Road, Prabhadevi, designed by Hafeez Contractor with interiors by PIA Interiors (Bangkok) and built by L&T. Towers A and B (Phase I) hold 4 and 5 BHK homes and have their Occupancy Certificate. Tower C (Phase II) holds 3 BHK homes and is still under construction.
notes: Rustomjee runs the project under a development management agreement. Listing sites also call the site 'DB Crown' / 'Rustomjee Orchid Crown' (DB Realty, now Valor Estate), and Housing.com maps P51900006367 to 'DB Crown Phase 2'. Phase I (Towers A and B) is MahaRERA P51900003268. Its RERA data shows 708 units, 450 sold (undated snapshot), proposed completion 30 Jun 2020 revised to 30 Dec 2022. Rustomjee says ready-to-move units have been available since December 2024, so the Phase I OC came about 4.5 years after the original RERA date. Phase II (Tower C) is P51900006367; Housiey lists its RERA possession as Dec 2026, and owners on PropertyButler say possession starts Sep 2026 (not confirmed by the developer). total_units is omitted because only the Phase I count (708) was found. Heights conflict: the 2019 launch release says Towers A and B are 68 storeys and Tower C 65; the developer site now says two towers of 68 and one of 67; Housiey lists 3B+G+9P+53. The launch release projected about Rs 5,800 crore of revenue. A Dec 2021 ANI/Business Standard release said 105 of the 282 premium-luxury registrations in the period were at Crown, with about Rs 42 crore stamp duty, and Rs 1,000 crore of sales. No launch-era (2019) per-sq-ft price was found.

unit_types.notes: In Tower C. Rs 9.45 Cr starting price from a Rustomjee blog (May 2025); the Housiey price sheet (Sep 2026) shows 1,335 sq ft at Rs 9.72 Cr and 1,483 sq ft at Rs 10.98 Cr, both marked sold out.
In Towers A and B. The developer site says 4 and 5 BHK start at Rs 17.01 Cr all-inclusive. Housiey price sheet (Sep 2026): 1,700 sq ft Rs 17.01 Cr; 2,500 sq ft Rs 19.80 Cr; 4,700 sq ft Rs 47.25 Cr.

price_points.note: Computed: 3 BHK of 1,335 sq ft at Rs 6.78 Cr (the listing shows Rs 50.78K/sq ft; page last updated Sep 2024). 1,335 sq ft matches the developer's smallest 3 BHK carpet size, but Housing labels it built-up.

Computed: the developer's 3 BHK starting price of Rs 9.45 Cr divided by the smallest 3 BHK carpet area (1,335 sq ft). Same post: 4 BHK from Rs 13.50 Cr (1,700 sq ft carpet min, about Rs 79,400/sq ft). Towers A and B had OC by then.
Square Yards says the Phase 2 (Tower C) average asking price moved from Rs 73,850 to Rs 75,050/sq ft during Q2 2026.
Computed: 4 BHK of 2,500 sq ft carpet at Rs 19.80 Cr all-inclusive (developer inventory in OC-received towers). The same sheet's 1,700 sq ft 4 BHK at Rs 17.01 Cr works out to about Rs 1,00,059/sq ft.

Median asking rate across 52 sale listings (range Rs 59,615 to 1,01,573/sq ft). PropertyButler uses 'total area' (carpet plus private foyer); elsewhere the same page gives a carpet median of Rs 80,814.

news.title: Rustomjee Launches Uber Luxury Project 'Rustomjee Crown' in Prabhadevi
news.summary: Launch of three towers (A and B at 68 storeys, C at 65) on 5.75 acres, with 3/4/5 BHK homes of 1,335-2,528 sq ft carpet and about Rs 5,800 crore expected revenue. HDFC is the funding partner and L&T the contractor.

news.title: Sales worth 1000 crores were recorded by Rustomjee Crown, an Uber Luxury Real Estate Project in Prabhadevi
news.summary: Rs 1,000 crore of sales; 105 of 282 premium-luxury registrations in the period were at Crown, with about Rs 42 crore stamp duty.

news.title: Rustomjee Crown: spacious residences (developer update)
news.summary: The developer says Towers A and B have received their Occupancy Certificate and ready-to-move units have been available since December 2024, against an original RERA completion date of June 2020 (revised to Dec 2022).
